name: shashank-workflows
description: Workflows written down step by step, each packaged as an agent skill: delivery loop, voice profile, measurement protocol, deliverable audit, presence map, and skill-from-setup.

plugins.name: delivery-loop
plugins.description: Runs a code change from request to an open pull request through eleven gated stages (route, grill, spec, slices, build, simplify, prune, dogfood, verify at the revision, two-axis review, ship) and leaves evidence at each stage.

plugins.name: voice-profile
plugins.description: Builds an explicit, testable voice profile from a writer's or company's existing samples, checks it against held-out samples, writes an editing brief, and reviews drafts with voice fit, pattern findings, factual evidence and approval kept as four separate reports.

plugins.name: measurement-protocol
plugins.description: Designs and runs a measurement of a noisy, moving system (for example how often a brand appears in AI answer engines) without inventing progress: one rule file, equal readings, held-out controls and brand questions, repeats clustered by question, a minimum detectable rate, a calibration run, and a list of blind spots.

plugins.name: deliverable-audit
plugins.description: Audits a library of digital products for broken or missing delivery links.

plugins.name: presence-map
plugins.description: Maps every public place a company controls where buyers and AI tools read about it (GitHub, package and image registries, model hubs, docs, MCP and agent directories), sorts the places into one-time and recurring, audits the one-time places against the company's own sources, and drafts the fixes.

plugins.name: skill-from-setup
plugins.description: Turns a one-time setup on one public place (a GitHub README, a registry listing, a directory entry, a profile page) into a reusable agent skill that any company can run.
